title: An issue or PR's own opening body claims a milestone number that doesn't exist
author: kwaku-ananse
description: Extracts every 'milestone #N' claim phrase (the shared seam_engine.milestone_claims grammar) from an issue or pull request's own OPENING BODY and checks whether the named milestone exists at all. issue-body-claims-open-milestone's own docstring named this exact seam and left it open on purpose: a claimed milestone number that names no real milestone at all was excluded there as belonging to issue-body-dangling-reference's own seam -- but that recipe only ever watches a bare #N against GitHub's shared issue/PR number sequence and never opens ListMilestones at all, so the milestone-claim leg of this surface had never actually been built anywhere. This recipe is the issue/PR-body-sourced sibling of commit-claims-dangling-milestone, which closed the identical seam for a commit message. Not whether a real milestone's claim is TRUE (issue-body-claims-open-milestone's own remit), but whether the number the claim names resolves to anything real.
confidence_notes: Flat 0.8, not age-gated -- mirrors commit-claims-dangling-milestone's and every other *-claims-dangling-milestone sibling's own reasoning rather than issue-body-claims-open-milestone's 24-hour edit-grace bar: an OPEN milestone could close at any moment, so a fresh claim about it might just be a race the body hasn't caught up to yet, but a milestone number that does not exist right now will not spontaneously start existing later, so there is no grace period that means anything here -- this holds even though an issue or PR body stays editable forever, because the editability of the surface has no bearing on whether the milestone NUMBER it names exists. A claimed milestone number that DOES resolve to a real milestone is excluded at confidence 0.0 regardless of whether that milestone is open or closed -- whether the claim is true is issue-body-claims-open-milestone's own seam, not this one's. A body with no 'milestone #N' claim phrase at all, or no body at all, produces no surfaced candidate -- there is no claim to have broken.
